//: Copy to ~/.yuneta/gobj-ui-consumers.json and fill in the apps of THIS
machine. It lives outside the repository on purpose: most consumers are
private, and their paths and hosts are not this package's business.
The DEMO (test-app -> demo.yuneta.io + niyamaka.com) is NOT listed here:
it is in the repo, so deploy-round.mjs carries it built in and always
runs it. That is the whole point -- it was the surface that kept being
forgotten, because it consumes the working tree and needs no registry.
name        what to call it in the report
path        the app that builds and deploys (npm run build runs here)
range_dirs  every dir declaring the @yuneta/gobj-ui range, if not just
`path` -- a workspace sibling keeps its own node_modules
and would install the version before behind the app
deploys     argv arrays, run from `path`
urls        what to read back afterwards; the entry bundle name of the
live page must match the one just built
test        optional: the argv that tests the app, run from `path`
AFTER the build and BEFORE the deploys (a red test leaves
it undeployed); default `npm test` when the app has one,
false for none
test_env    optional: environment for the test (e.g. CHROME_PATH)
A TEMPLATE (a scaffold apps are generated from) is a target with no
host: `range_dirs: []`, `range_files` (raised without a version of
their own), `install: false`, `build` (the check that generates an
app and builds it), `test: false`, and empty `deploys` and `urls`.
